short_blurb: From remodels to ground-up builds — your Culver City general contractor.
local_note: Culver City homeowners choose Palm Crest Builders for kitchen and bath remodels, room additions, ADUs, and whole-home renovations. We know the local building department, design for Culver City's mix of housing styles, and manage design, permits, and construction with our own licensed crews. We build throughout Culver City, including Downtown Culver City, Sunkist Park, Studio Village, and nearby neighborhoods. Every project is built to the California Building Code and backed by our workmanship warranty.

faqs.q: Do you pull building permits in Culver City?
faqs.a: Yes — we handle plans, plan check, and permits through the Culver City building and safety department for every remodel, addition, and ADU, and we schedule all required inspections.

faqs.q: Can I build an ADU in Culver City?
faqs.a: In most cases, yes. Under California and Culver City rules, most single-family lots qualify for a detached, attached, or garage-conversion ADU. We handle feasibility, design, permits, and construction.

faqs.q: How long will my Culver City remodel or addition take?
faqs.a: It depends on scope — bathrooms typically run 3–5 weeks, kitchens 4–8 weeks, and room additions 2–4 months. We give you a firm schedule with milestones in your written estimate.
